    target_dx = 0

    territory_dy = observation.get('territory_dy', None)

    # If we have a resource delta, bias toward it
    if resource_dx is not None and resource_dy is not None:

    if evader_dx is not None and evader_dy is not None:

        target_dx += (1 if evader_dx > 0 else -1 if evader_dx < 0 else 0)
        target_dy += (1 if evader_dy > 0 else -1 if evader_dy < 0 else 0)

    # Territory control: slightly bias toward center of territory region
    if territory_dx is not None and territory_dy is not None:
        target_dx += (1 if territory_dx > 0 else -1 if territory_dx < 0 else 0)
        target_dy += (1 if territory_dy > 0 else -1 if territory_dy < 0 else 0)

        gy = goal_y - y
        target_dx += (1 if gx > 0 else -1 if gx < 0 else 0)
        target_dy += (1 if gy > 0 else -1 if gy < 0 else 0)

    # Normalize to -1, 0, or 1 for each axis
    def clip1(v):
        if v > 0:
            return 1
        if v < 0:
            return -1
        return 0

    dx = clip1(target_dx)
    dy = clip1(target_dy)

    # If both zero (no info), bias toward center to stay safe
    if dx == 0 and dy == 0:
